author: Amelia N.
title: Exactly as pictured
body: Heavier than I expected in the best way — the drape is gorgeous and it doesn't need a scarf underneath.

author: Sofia M.
title: Runs slightly large
body: Beautiful coat, sized down and it's perfect. Would recommend checking the size guide first.

author: Julian B.
title: Worth every euro
body: Fourth winter coat I've bought from LUXE-style brands and this is the one that finally feels investment-grade.

author: Elena R.
title: Lovely fabric
body: The silk blend feels luxurious and doesn't wrinkle as much as I feared.

author: Marcus F.
title: Gift for my partner
body: She wears it constantly. The ivory colourway photographs beautifully too.

author: Nina K.
title: Soft and warm
body: No itch at all, and the charcoal colour goes with everything.

author: Leo M.
title: Great everyday sweater
body: Fits true to size. Only wish it came in more colours.

author: Amelia N.
title: Moves beautifully
body: The bias cut skirt really does move — got compliments all night.

author: Sofia M.
title: Nice but delicate
body: Gorgeous dress, just be careful — the fabric snags easily.
